compliance_condition: Must contain registered company name, complete address, and contact details.
violation_condition: Missing or incomplete manufacturer/packer name or postal address.

compliance_condition: Must declare generic or common name of the product in clear terms.
violation_condition: Generic name omitted or substituted solely by brand trade name.

statutory_reference: Rule 6(1)(c) & Schedule II - Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
compliance_condition: Net quantity expressed in standard metric units (g, kg, ml, L) matching Schedule II standard package sizes.
violation_condition: Non-metric units used, or net quantity deviates from Schedule II standard package sizes without exemption.

compliance_condition: Declared in format: 'Maximum Retail Price Rs. XX.XX' or 'MRP Rs. XX.XX' followed by '(inclusive of all taxes)'.
violation_condition: MRP declaration omits statutory phrase '(inclusive of all taxes)' or uses dual MRP pricing.

compliance_condition: Mandatory declaration 'Country of Origin: [Name of Country]' on all imported packaged commodities.
violation_condition: Country of origin declaration missing on imported product.

statutory_reference: Rule 7, Table-I - Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 (G.S.R. 629(E))
compliance_condition: Font height matches PDP Area (A) slab: A<=50cm² (min 1.0mm), 50<A<=100cm² (min 1.5mm), 100<A<=500cm² (min 2.5mm), 500<A<=2500cm² (min 4.0mm), A>2500cm² (min 6.0mm).
violation_condition: Letter or numeral height below statutory Table-I minimum height threshold for measured PDP area.

compliance_condition: Must state designated contact name/role, postal address, email ID, and telephone number.
violation_condition: Omission of any of the 4 mandatory customer care contact attributes (Name, Address, Email, Phone).

statutory_reference: First Schedule - Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
compliance_condition: Net quantity error within First Schedule MPE statutory percentage/weight tolerance bounds.
violation_condition: Negative net quantity deviation exceeds First Schedule statutory MPE limits.
